remaining_boundaries: No physical OLT or MikroTik was accessed; separate local RouterOS CHR execution is recorded in audit-results.json.
Per-ONU Ethernet port monitoring does not equal total subscriber usage.
WAN, WiFi, CATV and VoIP need compatible provisioning/ACS integration.
Multiple-service ONU edits intentionally fail before deleting other services.
A transport failure during a multi-step hardware change can require manual reconciliation; rollback errors are explicit.
